description: This file implements a remote JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) fetcher and verifier for OpenID Connect, including caching and concurrency control.

classes.name: remoteKeySet
classes.description: Manages fetching, caching, and verifying JSON Web Keys from a remote URL with concurrency control.

classes.name: inflight
classes.description: Represents an in-flight request to fetch keys, allowing multiple goroutines to wait for the result.

methods.name: NewRemoteKeySet
methods.description: Creates a new KeySet that fetches and caches JWKS from a remote URL.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a JWT signature using cached or remote keys, refreshing cache if expired.

methods.name: keysFromCache
methods.description: Returns cached keys and their expiry time.

methods.name: keysFromRemote
methods.description: Fetches keys from remote URL, updating cache with concurrency control.

methods.name: updateKeys
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET to retrieve JWKS and updates cache, returning keys and expiry.
